**🤖 AI Candidate Review** (auto-generated, not a team member)

**Fit summary:** Entry-level behavioral-health support background (Registered Behavior Technician) plus a relevant Psychology/Criminal Justice degree - a reasonable but light match for the pool given limited direct experience. **Strengths:** RBT experience using behavioral-data-collection software and following behavioral intervention plans; B.A. in Psychology and Criminal Justice from FAU; prior front-desk/call-center roles show reliability with sensitive documentation. **Gaps:** RBT role is very brief; no treatment-center or adolescent-specific experience listed. **Consistency check:** No contradictions found. **Tenure/timeline notes:** The RBT role is listed as lasting under a month (May 2025), and there's no listed employment since then (over a year gap to present) - both worth raising directly as questions (what happened with the RBT role, and what she's been doing since), not assumed reasons. **Recommendation:** Worth a brief outreach to understand the short RBT tenure and recent gap before deciding how active a fit she is for the pool.

**🤖 AI Candidate Review** (auto-generated, not a team member)

**Fit summary:** Strong general behavioral-health/social-work background - MSW plus direct experience supporting children with disabilities and families in crisis, a solid adjacent match for AWA/PRC's broader talent pool. **Strengths:** Family Support Specialist role at a children's emergency shelter (trauma-informed care, parent case management), prior Social Work Intern experience at the same organization, MSW from FAU (2022-2024). **Gaps:** No direct adult SUD/co-occurring treatment-center experience; current role (Medical Legal Screening Assessor) is outside behavioral-health service delivery. **Consistency check:** No contradictions between resume and profile found. **Tenure/timeline notes:** The Medical Legal Screening Assessor role is listed as current with a 2017 start date and overlaps entirely with her FL-based shelter and MSW work (different location - Toronto vs. Sunrise, FL) - worth a quick clarifying question on whether this is ongoing remote/part-time work and how it affects availability. Also a roughly 22-month gap in direct social-work employment since the Family Support Specialist role ended (Nov 2024) - worth asking what she's been doing in that window, not assuming a reason. **Recommendation:** Worth keeping in the talent pool and reaching out - relevant clinical/social-work training, just confirm current availability and the overlapping-role situation directly.
